findings.title: The proposed folder button loses its visible keyboard-focus indicator
acceptanceBinding: ECR-0008.packet.json W1.A09.T03 acceptance1: shared accessible DirectoryPickerField

findings.cause: The earlier :focus-visible rule and later .btn rule have equal specificity. The later .btn box-shadow overrides the token focus ring while the focus rule suppresses the outline. The new folder and retry compositions reuse this button. The preview helper records the ordinary shadow under visibleFocusStyle but asserts only activeElement, not a visible keyboard indicator.
